datasets.title: Pakistan - Settlement Catchment Areas
datasets.description: This dataset shows settlement-based catchment areas in Pakistan with information on total population disaggregated by sex and age and number of buildings.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/pakistan-settlement-catchment-areas]

lineage.description: Settlement catchment areas were generated by identifying population clusters using gridded population data (WorldPop, Kontur, Meta), assigning representative points to each cluster, and applying a catchment area algorithm to delineate settlement boundaries. Population totals were disaggregated by sex and age from multiple demographic sources, and building counts were derived from OpenStreetMap and Google building detection datasets to create a comprehensive settlement-level exposure inventory across six districts in Balochistan, Pakistan.

sources.name: WorldPop
sources.description: Gridded population estimates for 2020 used to identify settlement clusters and disaggregate population by location

sources.name: WorldPop UN
sources.description: UN-adjusted population estimates for 2020 integrated into settlement population totals

sources.name: Kontur
sources.description: High-resolution population distribution data from November 2023 used for settlement population estimation

sources.name: Meta
sources.description: Demographic data from April 2023 providing sex and age-disaggregated population counts (children under 5, ages 15-24, women 15-49, ages 60+)

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.description: Building footprints and counts from August 2024 contributing to settlement infrastructure inventory

sources.name: Google Buildings
sources.description: Machine-learning derived building footprints at 70% and 80% confidence thresholds for settlement structure mapping
